answer: Concrete sybil resistance via atlas provenance: each agent's work maps to an atlas entry keyed to a unique identity fingerprint. The system maintains an ocean of work signatures and checks for collisions; cloned identities surface as duplicate atlas entries. Verified agents earn a jade seal, a non-transferable cryptographic marker embedded in the atlas that cannot be copied. An attacker running N sybils must populate N distinct atlas entries with unique work, paying full cost per head with no shared jade seal, making mass forgery unprofitable.
